payload.title: File:Talentichthys kuragh (holotype, HRCT).jpg
payload.credit_html: "A new Devonian lungfish from the western Karakoram of northern Pakistan"
payload.description_html: ANU V3736 the holotype of Talentichthys kuragh, rendered images from HRCT data. Specimen in dorsal (A–C), ventral (D), lateral left (E), lateral right (F), and anterior (G) views. (A, D, E–G) 3D segmented ossified structures of the skull roof and braincase. (B) Skull roof transparent to show internal braincase structures, with rostral tubuli and anterior nerve canals. (C) Rostral tubuli and anterior nerve canals in snout region. (H) Extracted braincase ossifications in dorsal view, showing part of the cranial cavity. (I) Incomplete right pterygoid tooth plate showing enlarged anterior tooth. V, foramen for the profundus nerve. Not to scale.
